newsitem.title: USA: Noxso supply pact ends, says loan defaulted.
newsitem.headline: Noxso supply pact ends, says loan defaulted.

text.p: NOXSO Corp said on Sunday that Olin Corp has given notice of plans to end its supply agreement with NOXSO and declared NOXSO's $1.8 million note to Olin, due January 31, is in default.

NOXSO said also that Olin plans to take title to a facility built under the pact. NOXSO said it built the facility at Olin's Charleston, Tennessee, plant to convert elemental sulfur into liquid sulfur dioxide. Olin is to lease the facility and buy elemental sulfur from NOXSO for 10 years for $3.2 million a year, NOXSO said.
NOXSO said in a release that it has been working to obtain financing to repay its note to Olin and that it intends "to vigorously and aggressively pursue its rights and remedies against Olin."
